content: Multi-stage vision AI pipelines commonly order stages as: PII detection/classification -> quality gate/audit -> routing/output. Masking prevents redetection false-positives (reprocessing already-redacted regions). Real-time vs batch: cheap deterministic checks run inline, heavier ML/LLM stages run in an async worker queue. This validates SPEC.md's worker order (redact -> quality gate -> vision classify -> duplicate -> route), though industry examples typically redact AFTER classification (since classification needs to see faces/plates in context); SPEC.md redacts first for privacy-by-default, trading a small amount of classification context for stronger PDPA compliance -- a defensible choice given hazard evidence rarely depends on pixelated face/plate regions.
